items.title: 68533_Sam Jones oral history interview
items.q: And he called Bobby. Bobby came. And right away, man, rhythm section just took off. And uh, and he had Bobby Timmons playing the piano.

ctx.x: That's right. So, and so we uh, then we went to--first gig was out in Cleveland somewhere. We played out there, man and never could get nothing going, man, you know, really, really get some rhythm section, man. Kenny said, 'man, there's a So uh, we heard about Bobby Timmons. So uh ... little dude over in Philadelphia, little old dude over there, I heard about some--everybody's talking about, about say I'm going to call him. Well I got his number.' So he -- sure enough we called him up. It was Bobby Timmons. And…
